Author: MusicManBowls
Name: Hunt Train Relay
Description: Watches Hunt Helper's train via its IPC. Ends manually via End Train Now, posting a Discord report sorted by the order marks actually died, with Assumed Sniped detection for named marks never seen. Also supports on-demand scouting reports with multi-scout credit.
Punchline: Posts your hunt train's finish time + per-mark respawn estimates to Discord.
